Razorpay Test Mode

The existing Stage 4 page is a frontend test simulation. Real Razorpay order creation and verification must happen on the backend.

Frontend → Backend POST /api/payment/create-order ↓ Razorpay Checkout ↓ Backend verifies signature ↓ Order marked paid
Razorpay test credentials configured on backend

Important architecture note

This single HTML file is a complete standalone frontend/demo package, not a replacement for the real backend. The existing Stage 1–7 features remain browser-based where the original project implemented them with LocalStorage/sessionStorage. MongoDB, JWT, server-side authorization, real order persistence and real Razorpay verification require the Express backend described above.
